listing.title: My First Bath & Bedtime Coloring Book
listing.subtitle: 30 Big & Easy Bath & Bedtime Pages – Bubble Bath, Pillow, Moon & More for Kids Ages 2-5
listing.author: JONNY COLOR
listing.description_html:
Big, bold and easy to color: a first coloring book about bath time and bedtime!

Little hands color 30 bath and bedtime pictures, from a smiling bathtub full of bubbles, a toothbrush and a bar of soap to cozy pajamas, a sleepy bear in a nightcap, a moon wearing a nightcap and a sheep jumping a fence. Every page has one big, simple picture with extra-thick lines, many of them with smiling or sleepy faces, so small hands can color inside the lines, and each picture's name is written in big letters to color too.

Inside you'll find:

  • Bath time: Bubble Bath, Soap, Sponge, Towel, Shampoo, Toothbrush, Toothpaste, Hairbrush and Bathrobe
  • Getting ready for bed: Pajamas, Nightgown, Slippers, Bed, Bunk Bed, Crib, Pillow and Blanket
  • Night-time things: Moon, Stars, Night Light, Alarm Clock, Bedtime Story, Warm Milk, Baby Mobile, Music Box and Rocking Chair
  • Sleepy friends: Bedtime Bear, Counting Sheep, Sleepy Kitty and Sweet Dreams
  • One large picture per page with thick outlines
  • Single-sided pages with a blank back, so markers won't bleed onto the next picture
  • Big 8.5 x 11 inch pages and a "Great job!" certificate at the end

A fun, screen-free activity for toddlers and preschoolers ages 2 to 5.

Part of the my first step series.
